applicable-ollama: Applicable for some providers like Ollama
edit-default-templates-description: Edit the default templates used in the twinny extension.
embedding-options-no-providers-found: No providers found for type: 'embedding', please add an embedding provider...
label: Label
no-connections-found: No connections found. Please add a new connection to get started.
number-code-snippets: Most snippets one question may add to the prompt.
owner-repo-name: This tab will help you review pull requests in your repository, enter the owner and repository name below to get started. For now only GitHub is supported, set your GitHub token in the settings tab to get started.
placeholder: How can twinny help you today?
rerank-threshold-description: Snippets scoring below this are left out. Lower it if answers miss code you know is there; raise it if they quote unrelated code.
resize-composer: Drag to resize — double-click to reset
template-settings-description: Select the templates you want to use in the chat interface.
onboarding-description: Welcome to Twinny! Let's get you set up.
review-no-repository: Open a git repository to review local changes.
review-github-intro: Pull requests for the repository below. Detected from the git remote; edit the owner and repository to review another project. Set a GitHub token in the settings for private repositories.
review-how-it-works: Twinny sends the diff to your chat provider in parts sized for its context window; lockfiles, binaries and build output are skipped.
type-chat-blurb: Answers in the chat panel, code actions and reviews.
type-fim-blurb: Inline suggestions as you type. Needs a fill-in-the-middle capable model.
type-embedding-blurb: Indexes the workspace so chat can pull in related code.
no-providers-yet: No providers yet. Pick a preset below to get started.
hostname-hint: Just the host, e.g. localhost — a pasted URL is split into its parts.
api-path-hint-chat: The API base only; twinny adds /chat/completions itself.
models-not-listed: The server did not list its models; type the name.
fim-template-hint: Automatic picks the template from the model name. Set it by hand if suggestions look wrong.
reset-providers-confirm: Remove all providers and start over?
setup-all-good: Everything answers. You're good to go.
setup-missing-chat: Nothing will answer in the chat panel until a chat provider is set.
setup-missing-fim: Inline suggestions are off until an autocomplete provider is set.
setup-missing-embedding: Optional. Without it, chat cannot search the workspace for related code.
preset-intro-chat: Choose where chat requests go. Local servers keep everything on your machine.
preset-intro-fim: Choose the server that will complete code as you type. A base or code model works best; instruct models tend to chatter.
preset-intro-embedding: Choose the server that turns your files into vectors for workspace search.
preset-ollama: Runs models locally. Install from ollama.com, then pull a model.
preset-lmstudio: Desktop app with a local server on port 1234.
preset-openai-compatible: Any server that speaks the OpenAI API, e.g. vLLM or TGI.
preset-openwebui: Open WebUI proxying Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible backend.
preset-litellm: A LiteLLM proxy in front of hosted APIs.
preset-oobabooga: text-generation-webui with the API extension on.
preset-openai: GPT models. Needs an API key from platform.openai.com.
preset-anthropic: Claude models. Needs an API key from console.anthropic.com.
preset-deepseek: DeepSeek chat and coder models. Needs an API key.
preset-gemini: Google Gemini. Needs an API key from AI Studio.
preset-groq: Fast hosted open models. Needs an API key.
preset-mistral: Mistral and Codestral. Needs an API key.
preset-openrouter: One key for many hosted models.
preset-cohere: Command models. Needs an API key.
preset-perplexity: Sonar models with web search. Needs an API key.
welcome-intro: Twinny talks to a model server of your choice. Use one already running on this machine, or pick a hosted API.
welcome-searching: Looking for a server on this machine…
welcome-none-found: Nothing answered on the usual ports. Start Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or another local server and search again, or choose a provider yourself.
empty-chat-no-provider: No chat provider is set, so nothing will answer yet.
chat-disabled-no-provider: Set up a chat provider first.
embeddings-intro: Index the workspace so chat can find the code a question is about. Type @workspace in a message to use it, or turn on automatic use below.
embeddings-not-indexed: Not indexed yet. Nothing happens until you index the workspace.
embeddings-provider-hint: Changing the model means re-indexing: vectors from different models do not mix.
embeddings-chunking-blurb: Files are split into chunks along syntax boundaries before embedding. Smaller chunks match more precisely; larger ones carry more context.
embeddings-chunking-note: Changing these means a rebuild, since existing chunks keep their old sizes.
embeddings-min-below-max: Must be smaller than the max chunk size.
embeddings-overlap-below-min: Must be smaller than the min chunk size.
embeddings-retrieval-blurb: How much of the index one question pulls into the prompt. Results are ranked by a cross-encoder that reads the question with each snippet.
device-not-paired: This device is no longer paired. Remove the provider or pair the device again.
device-ollama-down: Ollama is not running on the device
devices-blurb: Use another computer's GPU over an encrypted peer-to-peer link.
pairing-code-hint: On the computer with the GPU, open Twinny → Providers → Devices and press Start sharing (or run `twinny-node` in a terminal), then paste the pairing code it shows. The code works once and expires after ten minutes.
pairing-code-placeholder: Paste the code shown by the node
remove-device-confirm: Unpair {{name}}? Providers that use it will be removed.
device-job-active: Active for {{job}}. Click to change the model.
device-job-set: Set up for {{job}}. Click to switch to it.
host-running-elsewhere: Shared from another VS Code window.
host-blurb: Share this computer's Ollama with your other devices. Nothing is exposed to the internet; only devices you pair can use it.
host-no-peers: No devices are paired with this computer yet.
pairing-code-share-hint: On your other device: Twinny → Providers → Devices → Add device, and paste this code. It works once.
host-port-hint: Other devices reach this computer on UDP port {{port}}. If this computer runs a firewall, allow that port, e.g. `sudo ufw allow {{port}}/udp`.
apply-code: Apply to the editor as a diff you can accept or reject
embeddings-update-hint: Embed only the files that changed since the last run.
embeddings-rebuild-hint: Start over. Needed after changing the embedding model or the chunk sizes.
embeddings-model-changed: The index was built with {{indexed}} but the active provider uses {{active}}. Vectors from different models do not mix: rebuild before searching.
embeddings-automatic: Use the index for every message
embeddings-automatic-blurb: Off: only messages that mention @workspace search the index. On: every message does, which suits large codebases and capable models; small local models can get distracted by extra context.
